## 2024-05-29 - Iframe Titles for Data Visualizations
**Learning:** Screen readers cannot parse the complex internal contents of data visualization iframes generated by Plotly or similar libraries. Without a descriptive `title` attribute on the `<iframe>` element itself, screen reader users encounter a generic, inaccessible block.
**Action:** Always add clear, descriptive `title` attributes to `<iframe>` elements that embed data visualizations, explicitly describing what the visualization represents (e.g., "Strategy comparison: Steps to fb Convergence") to ensure proper context for assistive technologies.

## 2024-05-29 - Hidden Inputs Need Labels
**Learning:** Adding inputs like range sliders (`<input type="range">`) or dropdowns without visible text labels makes them inaccessible to screen readers.
**Action:** When creating form controls or interactive inputs without a visible `<label>`, always include an `aria-label` attribute providing the necessary context.
